caseNameFull: Felder v. Johnson, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Institutional Division
judges: Application, Execution, Ginsburg, Grant, Stay, Stevens

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Scalia, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied.

Justice Stevens, Justice Ginsburg, and Justice Breyer would grant the application for stay of execution.
